newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS -- KLM and Hoogovens active on EOE.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -- KLM and Hoogovens active on EOE.

text.p: Options in KLM and steel and aluminium maker Hoogovens were active on the European Options Exchange (EOE) on Tuesday but overall volumes were light, reflecting continued investor jitters over near-term direction.

Dealers said institutional investors were active in KLM options with trade noted in January 45 guilder puts and 47.50 calls. Hoogovens was active as bullish expectations continued to surround the stock and options gave private investors a cheap way to buying into any upside, they said. Both captured around 10 percent each of a total, dominated by the EOE contract with nearly 30 percent. -- Amsterdam newsdesk +31 20 504 5000
